children: Hartree Partners, Lp, a 10% Owner, reported a purchase of Hudson Technologies common stock on 2026-09-24. The report lists a weighted average purchase price of $5.0987 per share for the transactions. The total purchase amount reported is $604,445. Following the reported purchase, Hartree Partners, Lp directly owns 5,348,517 shares of Hudson Technologies. The reporting person disclaims beneficial ownership of the securities reported except to the extent of its pecuniary interest therein.
